Paying the $19,000 isn't "paying off your PMI". All you're doing is getting your balance down to <80% loan to value so that legally you are not required to have PMI which... is totally fine if you want to do that.

However, a much cheaper solution would be to actually buy out your PMI. You could for example refinance your home and buy out the PMI up-front for a fraction of that $19,000.

Another solution is to refinance with a 80/10/10 loan and also skip PMI without buying it out. Check it out....good luck.
